title: For a functor of sites preserving sheaves, u_s = (u_p -)^# is left adjoint to u^s (Stacks 00WX)
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal D$ be sites, each a site in the sense of Stacks Sites, Definition 00VH: a category whose objects and morphisms form sets, with a set $\operatorname{Cov}$ of families $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ (coverings) such that every isomorphism $\{V\to U\}$ is a covering, if $\{U_i\to U\}_{i}$ and $\{V_{ij}\to U_i\}_{j}$ for every $i$ are coverings then $\{V_{ij}\to U\}_{i,j}$ is a covering, and for a covering $\{U_i\to U\}$ and a morphism $V\to U$ the fibre products $U_i\times_UV$ exist and $\{U_i\times_UV\to V\}$ is a covering. A sheaf of sets (resp. of abelian groups) on a site is a presheaf $\mathcal F$ of sets (resp. abelian groups) such that for every covering $\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in I}$ the diagram $\mathcal F(U)\to\prod_i\mathcal F(U_i)\rightrightarrows\prod_{i,j}\mathcal F(U_i\times_UU_j)$ is an equalizer (Sites, Definitions 00VM and 00VR; [lem-weil-pbc-sheaf-algebraic-structures-objects]); morphisms are natural transformations. Let $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ be a functor such that $\mathcal G\circ u$ is a sheaf of sets on $\mathcal C$ for every sheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $\mathcal D$. Let $\mathcal A$ be the category of sets or the category of abelian groups, and $\mathrm{PSh}(-,\mathcal A)\supseteq\Sh(-,\mathcal A)$ the categories of presheaves and of sheaves with values in $\mathcal A$. Then: (1) for every sheaf $\mathcal G$ on $\mathcal D$ with values in $\mathcal A$, $\mathcal G\circ u$ is a sheaf on $\mathcal C$ with values in $\mathcal A$, so that $u^s:\Sh(\mathcal D,\mathcal A)\to\Sh(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)$, $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G\circ u$, $\psi\mapsto(\psi_{u(V)})_V$, is a functor; (2) for $\mathcal F\in\mathrm{PSh}(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)$ and $W\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal D)$ let $\mathcal I_W$ be the category of pairs $(V,\phi)$ with $V\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C)$, $\phi:W\to u(V)$ (morphisms $f:V\to V'$ with $u(f)\circ\phi=\phi'$) and $u_p\mathcal F(W)=\varinjlim_{(V,\phi)\in\mathcal I_W^{op}}\mathcal F(V)$ (colimit in $\mathcal A$), a presheaf on $\mathcal D$ functorial in $\mathcal F$; let $u_s\mathcal F=(u_p\mathcal F)^\#$ be its sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] for $\mathcal F\in\Sh(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)$. Then $u_s:\Sh(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)\to\Sh(\mathcal D,\mathcal A)$ is a left adjoint of $u^s$: $\operatorname{Mor}_{\Sh(\mathcal D,\mathcal A)}(u_s\mathcal F,\mathcal G)=\operatorname{Mor}_{\Sh(\mathcal C,\mathcal A)}(\mathcal F,u^s\mathcal G)$ bifunctorially, the bijection being the composite of the adjunctions $u_p\dashv u^p$ (Sites, Lemma 00VE) and $\#\dashv$ inclusion. (Stacks Sites, Lemma 00WX, for sheaves of sets; for abelian groups the same proof with the colimits taken in abelian groups.)
